propositions: jql_active query hardcodes status != 'Done' literal, which does not recognize custom closed-equivalent statuses like Closed/Resolved/Cancelled, causing them to be incorrectly pulled into the active working set
jql_done_recent query uses status = 'Done' literal and misses issues in custom Done-category statuses, leaving them out of the recent-Done snapshot
Switch from literal status predicates to statusCategory = Done / statusCategory != Done to be workflow-agnostic and support any Jira workflow's custom statuses that map to the Done category
jql_active must exclude all statuses in the Done statusCategory; jql_done_recent must select the Done statusCategory with ORDER BY updated DESC
Single-project and multi-project fan-out behavior and DIG/REB workflow scoping must remain unchanged after the statusCategory switch
